sync.title: Export folder
sync.intro: Open this page on the shop PC, in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, and connect the folder your stock software exports to. While the page is open (minimised is fine) it checks the folder every 15 minutes and sends the newest stock file to PPI. PPI only reads that one folder and changes nothing on the PC.
sync.unsupported: Folder connection works only in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome on a computer. This browser (for example Firefox or Safari) cannot do it. Open this page in Edge or Chrome on the shop PC.
sync.no_shop: Add your shop first under “My shop”.
sync.allow_hint: After the PC restarts, the browser asks once more. Choose “Allow on every visit” so it does not ask again.
sync.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again on this PC, then reopen this page.
sync.other_window: PPI is already watching this folder in another window or tab. This one takes over when the other one is closed.
sync.no_file: No stock file in this folder yet (XML, CSV, TXT or XLSX).
sync.settling: The newest file was written less than a minute ago. It is sent as soon as the export is finished.
sync.up_to_date: The newest file has already been sent.
sync.send_failed: Sending failed: {error}. PPI tries again at the next check.
sync.result_updated: Stock sent. Items updated: {items}; set to out of stock (missing from the file): {zeroed}.
sync.result_unchanged: This file had already been sent.
sync.result_proposed: File received (rows: {rows}). Now check its columns once under My shop → Stock file columns and approve them; after that your stock appears automatically.
sync.result_waiting_for_approval: File received (rows: {rows}). Waiting for you to approve its columns under My shop.
sync.result_layout_changed: The file’s layout has changed (rows: {rows}). Your previous stock stays visible until you approve the new columns under My shop.
sync.result_error: The file could not be read: {error}
sync.picker_failed: The folder could not be opened: {error}
sync.install_intro: Install PPI as an app, then let it start with Windows, so the folder is checked even after a restart.
sync.installed: You are using the installed PPI app.
sync.install_manual: No button? In Edge: menu (⋯) → Apps → Install this site as an app. In Chrome: menu (⋮) → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.
sync.autostart_title: Open PPI automatically when Windows starts:
sync.autostart_1: Start → All apps → right-click “PPI” → More → Open file location.
sync.autostart_2: Select the “PPI” shortcut and copy it (Ctrl+C).
sync.autostart_3: Press Windows+R, type shell:startup and press Enter.
sync.autostart_4: Paste the shortcut into the folder that opens (Ctrl+V).
sync.keep_awake: The PC must not go to sleep during opening hours: Settings → System → Power → Sleep: Never.

owner.country_hint: Two letters, e.g. SK, HU, AT, CZ, PL, DE
owner.map_hint: Click your shop's spot on the map, or type the coordinates.
owner.create_intro: Fill in the basics. You can change everything later.
owner.created: Your shop is created. Next steps:
owner.step_folder: On the PC with your stock software, open “Export folder” in the menu and connect the folder your stock software exports to.
owner.step_columns: When the first file arrives, check below which column is which and approve.
owner.step_visible: Keep “Visible to shoppers” ticked in the shop details.
owner.columns_intro: Tell PPI which column of your stock file holds which information. PPI suggests it automatically; you only check and approve, once.
owner.columns_waiting: No file has arrived yet. Connect the export folder on the shop PC first.
owner.state_confirmed: Approved – new files are applied automatically.
owner.columns_saved: Columns approved. The PPI window on the shop PC sends the file again at its next check (or click “Check now” there).
owner.folder_seen: PPI window on the shop PC last active
owner.delete_intro: Removes the shop, its items and its stock from PPI. This cannot be undone.
owner.error_limit: An account can have at most 5 shops.
owner.error_columns: Item code, name, quantity and price must each be a column of your file.
owner.export_rules_title: Rules for the export from your stock software
owner.rule_folder: A folder used only for this, e.g. C:\Export. PPI sends the newest file in it.
owner.rule_format: XML, CSV (UTF-8 or Windows-1250, separated by ; or ,) or Excel .xlsx – not the old .xls.
owner.rule_columns: Columns: item code, item name, quantity in stock, selling price incl. VAT; EAN and brand if available.
owner.rule_all: All items in one file, always the same file name, overwritten each time. An item missing from the file counts as sold out.
owner.rule_schedule: Every 15–30 minutes during opening hours, plus once at night.
owner.rule_public: Only public information: no purchase prices, suppliers or customer data.
owner.rule_pc: The PC stays on during opening hours with this page or the PPI app open (minimised is fine).
owner.error_translation: Enter at least one translation (up to 300 characters).
owner.error_plan_active: This shop has a paid plan that still renews. Cancel it first under Plan → Manage subscription.
owner.error_plan_unavailable: Paid plans are not available yet.
owner.error_email: This is not a valid e-mail address.
owner.error_facebook: Enter a link to a page on facebook.com or fb.com, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/yourshop.
owner.error_no_plan: This is part of the paid plan.
owner.private_columns_note: Columns you don't choose here (e.g. purchase price, supplier, margin) are private: never shown anywhere and never sent to the assistant.
owner.delete_summary: Removes the shop from PPI for good

privacy_assistant.title: Privacy in the shop assistant
privacy_assistant.draft: Draft text – the final wording is being prepared.
privacy_assistant.what: If the shop has the Pro plan, every conversation with its assistant is stored: your messages, the assistant's answers with the items it showed you (name, price and availability at that moment) and the files you send. Location data (GPS) is removed from photos. Access keys are never stored in the conversation.
privacy_assistant.who: Only the owners of this shop, in My shop. Other shops and visitors cannot see it.
privacy_assistant.time: A conversation ends after 30 minutes without a message or when you close the chat. The shop keeps it for 30, 90 or 365 days (its own setting, 90 days if not set); then it is deleted with its files.
privacy_assistant.delete: While the chat is open, you can delete the conversation and files with “Delete my conversation”. Later, please ask the shop directly.

cloud.title: Cloud folder
cloud.intro: Every finished conversation of the assistant is saved to your OneDrive or Dropbox: the conversation's PDF and the shopper's files.
cloud.needs_plan: The cloud folder is part of the Pro plan.
cloud.unavailable: The cloud folder is not switched on yet (database update 23).
cloud.folder_hint: If the folder does not exist, we create it.
cloud.structure: Each conversation gets its own folder: {folder}/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM_id/ with konverzacia.pdf and a subory folder.
cloud.share_link: A share link (e.g. 1drv.ms, onedrive.live.com or dropbox.com/scl/…) is not enough: a folder usually cannot be written to through a share link. Connect OneDrive or Dropbox with the button below instead and enter the folder as a path, e.g. /Cacadoo/Shop.
cloud.permission_onedrive: OneDrive: Microsoft asks to “read and write your files”; it has no narrower permission for one folder. PPI works only in the folder you choose.
cloud.permission_dropbox: Dropbox: create folders, upload files and list them (so nothing is saved twice).
cloud.permission_common: We never overwrite or delete anything: a new file with the same name gets a number, e.g. “(2)”. Access is stored encrypted and “Disconnect” deletes it.
cloud.status_expired: The cloud connection has expired – connect it again
cloud.failing_since: Saving has been failing since {when}. If it goes on for 24 hours, we will e-mail you.
cloud.folder_failed: The folders could not be loaded. Try again.
cloud.backfill_intro: Uploads, once, the conversations of the chosen period that are not in the cloud yet.
cloud.disconnect_confirm: Yes, disconnect the cloud. Files already in the cloud stay there.
cloud.disconnect_microsoft: You can also remove the permission in your Microsoft account (Apps and services).
cloud.ok_connected: The cloud is connected. Conversations will be saved automatically.
cloud.ok_disconnected: The cloud is disconnected and the access deleted.
cloud.ok_backfill: Conversations waiting to be saved to the cloud: {n}.
cloud.ok_retry: We will try to save the conversation again.
cloud.error_denied: You did not confirm the connection. Try again.
cloud.error_failed: The connection did not work. Try again.

cloud.error_not_configured: The cloud connection is not set up yet (the app keys are missing in Supabase).
cloud.error_no_plan: The cloud folder is part of the Pro plan.
cloud.error_expired: The cloud connection has expired – connect it again
